questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.**

Although she was tired, she kept working on her project, ______ (**indefinite**) to finish it before the deadline.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"bounded."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Indefinite"** means without limits or boundaries. (बिना किसी सीमा या सीमा के)

 
 
• **Example**: *Our plans are still rather **indefinite**__.*
 
 
 
• The antonym of** "indefinite" **is **"bounded."**
 
• **"Bounded"** means having limits or boundaries. (सीमा होना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The town is **bounded**__ on one side by a river.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that the person is determined to finish the project before the deadline despite feeling tired.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Although she was tired, she kept working on her project, __**bounded**__ to finish it before the deadline.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (contingently) **means dependent on certain conditions or circumstances. (कुछ शर्तों या परिस्थितियों पर निर्भर)
 
• **Option 3 (incensed)** means very angry or enraged. (अतिक्रुद्घ)
 
• **Option 4 (believed) **means accepted something as true or real without proof or evidence. (विश्‍वास करना, सही मान लेना)

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.**

I have been living in this country **__since last several years__** but have never experienced any discrimination.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** "for the last several years."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **‘since’** is used to refer to a time (an action that begun in the past and is still continuing).

 
 
• **Example**: *We have been married **since**__ 1996.*
 
 
 
• The word **‘for’ **is used to show a period of time in the past, present, or future.
 __
 
• **Example**: *I was waiting **for**__ an hour.*
 
 
 
• The phrase** "for the last several years" **is grammatically correct and means the same thing as the original sentence.
 
• The use of** "last"** indicates that the speaker is referring to a specific period of time that has already passed.
 
• Generally, when** "last"** followed by a noun, the definite article "the" is used before it.
 __
 
• **Example**: *It was **the last**__ time I won.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *I have been living in this country for the last several years but have never experienced any discrimination.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

An inquiry is demanded by us.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"We demand an inquiry."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Passive Voice and Simple Present tense. 
 
• As per the given question, we have to change it into Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject (objective case)+ is/am/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
• Subject + V1(s/es)+ Object. (Active Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *They are shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
• *Their cousin show them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'inquiry' and the object is 'us.' 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• 'Is demanded' will be changed into 'demand.' 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 2.'

 

Correct sentence: *We demand an inquiry.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the following sentence in active voice.**

The other details will be given by the concerned teacher.

options.text: The concerned teacher gave the other details.
The concerned teacher will give the other details.
The concerned teacher will give other details.
The teacher will give the other concerned details.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"The concerned teacher will give the other details."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Future Tense and in Passive Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Future Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• To convert a sentence from passive voice to active voice, we need to identify the subject (who is performing the action) and make it the subject of the sentence.
 
 
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Object + will + be + V3 + by Subject (Passive Voice)__
 
• Subject + will + V1 + object __(Active Voice__)
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *A song will be sung by Esha.​ *(Passive Voice)
 
• *Esha will sing a song. *(Active Voice)
 
 
 
• In active voice, the subject (other details) performs the action (giving) on the object (concerned teacher).
 
• In this case, the subject is "concerned teacher" and the object is "other details."
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The concerned teacher will give the other details.*

questions.question:
**Direction: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. As people huddled under tents and tarps, they wondered if the festival would ever be the same again.

B. However, as the sun began to set, a massive storm cloud rolled in, and lightning streaked across the sky.

C. The music festival was in full swing, with dozens of bands performing on multiple stages throughout the day.

D. The organisers frantically tried to evacuate the festival-goers, but the sudden downpour made it nearly impossible to move through the mud-soaked fields.

E. The crowds were massive, and the energy was electric as fans danced and sang along to their favourite songs.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"CEBDA."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph talks about a music festival that was interrupted by a sudden storm, causing chaos and uncertainty among the festival-goers.
 
• Sentence C sets the context by introducing the festival and its lively atmosphere. So, it must be the first sentence.
 
• Sentence E provides further description of the festival, emphasizing the size of the crowds and the excitement of the fans. So, E must follow C.
 
• Sentence B introduces the conflict by describing the sudden storm that disrupted the festival. So, B must follow E.
 
• Sentence D describes the organizers' efforts to evacuate the attendees, but the difficult conditions caused by the heavy rain and mud made it a challenging task. So, D must follow B.
 
• Sentence A concludes the paragraph by highlighting the uncertainty and concern among the festival-goers about the future of the event. So, the last sentence must be A.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

**Correct sequence**:

C. The music festival was in full swing, with dozens of bands performing on multiple stages throughout the day.

E. The crowds were massive, and the energy was electric as fans danced and sang along to their favourite songs.

B. However, as the sun began to set, a massive storm cloud rolled in, and lightning streaked across the sky.

D. The organisers frantically tried to evacuate the festival-goers, but the sudden downpour made it nearly impossible to move through the mud-soaked fields.

A. As people huddled under tents and tarps, they wondered if the festival would ever be the same again.
